Messages.Author: ICL
Messages.Body:
> Maddog wrote:
> There is too many irreverent /personal questions on this survey. I don't give to telemarketing sales people this information either. Why do they need to know sexual preference or annual salary?
>
While it may be true that someone can just skip the questions, I think it's a terrible idea to be asking these questions in the first place. It's far too much personal information that someone may provide because they aren't savvy enough to avoid doing so. It also just skews the data in that only certain people will answer certain questions, defeating the purpose of trying to get relevant statistical data.
